parameters.query:
WITH next_job AS (
    SELECT id

    FROM automation_jobs

    WHERE job_type =
        'create_campaign_workspace'

      AND status = 'queued'

      AND available_at <= NOW()

      AND attempts < max_attempts

    ORDER BY
        available_at,
        created_at

    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = j.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM next_job n

    WHERE j.id = n.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts
)

SELECT
    claimed_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    claimed_job.status AS job_status,
    claimed_job.attempts,

    c.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    c.campaign_code,
    c.brief,
    c.status AS campaign_status,
    c.drive_folder_id,

    cv.id::TEXT AS campaign_version_id,
    cv.version_number,
    cv.content AS approved_content,

    a.reviewer_name,
    a.reviewer_email,
    a.feedback AS approval_feedback,

    cl.client_code,
    cl.client_name,
    cl.company_name,
    cl.email AS client_email,
    cl.website

FROM claimed_job

JOIN campaigns c
    ON c.id = claimed_job.campaign_id

JOIN campaign_versions cv
    ON cv.id =
       claimed_job.campaign_version_id

JOIN approvals a
    ON a.id = claimed_job.approval_id

JOIN (
    SELECT
        id,
        client_code,
        name AS client_name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website
    FROM clients
) cl
    ON cl.id = c.client_id;

parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

validated_input AS (
    SELECT
        (data->>'job_id')::UUID
            AS job_id,

        (data->>'campaign_id')::UUID
            AS campaign_id,

        NULLIF(
            data->>'folder_id',
            ''
        ) AS folder_id,

        NULLIF(
            data->>'pdf_file_id',
            ''
        ) AS pdf_file_id,

        NULLIF(
            data->>'pdf_file_name',
            ''
        ) AS pdf_file_name,

        NULLIF(
            data->>'pdf_drive_url',
            ''
        ) AS pdf_drive_url

    FROM input_data

    WHERE NULLIF(
        data->>'job_id',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
        data->>'campaign_id',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
        data->>'folder_id',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
        data->>'pdf_file_id',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
        data->>'pdf_file_name',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
        data->>'pdf_drive_url',
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL
),

complete_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs

    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM validated_input

    WHERE automation_jobs.id =
        validated_input.job_id

      AND automation_jobs.campaign_id =
        validated_input.campaign_id

      AND automation_jobs.job_type =
        'create_campaign_workspace'

      AND automation_jobs.status =
        'processing'

    RETURNING
        automation_jobs.id,
        automation_jobs.job_type,
        automation_jobs.campaign_id,
        automation_jobs.campaign_version_id,
        automation_jobs.approval_id,
        automation_jobs.status,
        automation_jobs.attempts,
        automation_jobs.max_attempts,
        automation_jobs.completed_at,
        automation_jobs.updated_at
),

update_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns

    SET
        drive_folder_id =
            validated_input.folder_id,

        pdf_file_id =
            validated_input.pdf_file_id,

        pdf_file_name =
            validated_input.pdf_file_name,

        pdf_drive_url =
            validated_input.pdf_drive_url,

        delivery_ready_at = NOW(),

        status = 'completed'

    FROM validated_input

    JOIN complete_job
        ON complete_job.campaign_id =
           validated_input.campaign_id

    WHERE campaigns.id =
        complete_job.campaign_id

    RETURNING
        campaigns.id,
        campaigns.campaign_code,
        campaigns.status,
        campaigns.drive_folder_id,
        campaigns.pdf_file_id,
        campaigns.pdf_file_name,
        campaigns.pdf_drive_url,
        campaigns.delivery_ready_at,
        campaigns.updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '10 - Campaign Workspace Worker',

        complete_job.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'campaign_workspace_created',

        'The approved campaign PDF and Google Drive workspace were created successfully.',

        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'job_id',
                complete_job.id,

            'job_type',
                complete_job.job_type,

            'campaign_code',
                update_campaign.campaign_code,

            'campaign_version_id',
                complete_job.campaign_version_id,

            'approval_id',
                complete_job.approval_id,

            'folder_id',
                update_campaign.drive_folder_id,

            'pdf_file_id',
                update_campaign.pdf_file_id,

            'pdf_file_name',
                update_campaign.pdf_file_name,

            'pdf_drive_url',
                update_campaign.pdf_drive_url,

            'delivery_ready_at',
                update_campaign.delivery_ready_at,

            'campaign_status',
                update_campaign.status,

            'attempts',
                complete_job.attempts
        )

    FROM complete_job

    JOIN update_campaign
        ON update_campaign.id =
           complete_job.campaign_id

    RETURNING
        id,
        event_type,
        created_at
)

SELECT
    complete_job.id::TEXT
        AS job_id,

    complete_job.job_type,

    complete_job.status
        AS job_status,

    complete_job.attempts,

    complete_job.max_attempts,

    complete_job.completed_at,

    update_campaign.id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    update_campaign.campaign_code,

    update_campaign.status
        AS campaign_status,

    update_campaign.drive_folder_id,

    update_campaign.pdf_file_id,

    update_campaign.pdf_file_name,

    update_campaign.pdf_drive_url,

    update_campaign.delivery_ready_at,

    update_campaign.updated_at,

    write_log.id::TEXT
        AS automation_log_id

FROM complete_job

JOIN update_campaign
    ON update_campaign.id =
       complete_job.campaign_id

LEFT JOIN write_log
    ON TRUE;
